summary: Claude Code before 2.0.65 sends API requests to a project-supplied base URL before trust prompt
details: Claude Code before 2.0.65 honoured an API base URL set in a project's settings file and issued requests before showing the trust prompt. Opening an attacker-supplied repository could disclose the user's API key to an attacker-controlled endpoint.

database_specific.why: AVE mirrors component-level records into OSV form so existing OSV scanners can use them without knowing AVE exists. Records OSV cannot express faithfully are marked. See ALTERNATIVES.md.
